_meta.source: 2026-09-07 依客戶提供簡報「MitoBitTech management team website.pptx」第 2 頁「What Differentiating NovaRadar to Accelerate Success」置換原本 4 項假設性文案，改為 6 項；2026-09-08 依客戶提供更新版簡報「MitoBitTech management team website_20260908.pptx」第 2 頁，6 項 description 全面改寫（標題不變）；英文為簡報原文（權威來源，經潤飾為完整句子），繁中為翻譯

items.description_zhTW: 瑞大生技的團隊成員本身就是新藥開發人員、生醫專業人士與連續創業家，曾親自打造並擴大企業規模。瑞大生技以營運者的眼光——而非僅止於投資人的角度——評估每個投資機會。
items.description_en: NovaRadar's team members are drug developers, biomedical professionals, and serial entrepreneurs who have built and scaled companies themselves. NovaRadar evaluates every opportunity with an operator's eye, not just an investor's.

items.description_zhTW: 多數生技延遲的根源都指向 CMC（化學、製造與管制）。瑞大生技將此視為優勢，及早為製造與法規策略降低風險，避免價值在後期流失。
items.description_en: A majority of biotech delays trace back to CMC. NovaRadar treats it as an edge — de-risking manufacturing and regulatory strategy early, before it erodes value.

items.title_en: Speed to Clinical Proof of Concept
items.description_zhTW: 不只優化 IRR，瑞大生技更著重縮短達到關鍵反曲點所需的時間。
items.description_en: Beyond optimizing IRR, NovaRadar optimizes time to the key inflection point.

items.description_zhTW: 許多基金宣稱全球佈局，真正具備全球營運能力的卻不多。瑞大生技串連美國、台灣與歐洲，橫跨科學、CMC、臨床開發、量產、商業開發與資本。
items.description_en: Many funds invest globally; few operate globally. NovaRadar connects the US, Taiwan, and Europe across science, CMC, clinical development, manufacturing, BD, and capital.

items.title_zhTW: 藥廠商業化思維與出場導向投資
items.description_zhTW: 瑞大生技不只從技術角度思考，而是以產品角度出發：能否量產？能否符合商業化量產品質？能否取得 FDA 核准？能否吸引藥廠併購？
items.description_en: Rather than think in terms of technology, NovaRadar thinks in terms of product: can it scale, be manufactured at commercial quality, win FDA approval, and attract a pharma acquirer?

items.description_zhTW: 瑞大生技不僅止於董事會治理，更捲起袖子與創辦人並肩投入執行面，而非只是監督。
items.description_en: NovaRadar goes beyond board governance, rolling up its sleeves to work alongside founders on execution — not just oversight.
